posts.title: Hong Kong gov’t defends moving Wang Fuk Court fire tributes on first anniversary of deadly blaze
posts.description: Floral tributes for the victims of last year’s deadly Wang Fuk Court fire were relocated on Thursday to make room for more mourners, the government has said.
